note: The Banco Comercial do Atlântico's price list (in force from 30 July 2026): its BCA Visa Classic credit card's annual fee is 4,000 escudos plus 3.5% stamp duty on it, 4,140 in all, and its nominal annual rate is 18.250% (22.345% effective); the stamp duty on interest and on the average balance isn't written.
